title: The Sick Village
text: Everyone in this village is ill with something that turns the skin to bark, cracked and rough, while the eyes go green and blind. They beg for help from a careful distance, holding out stiff wooden hands. A child among them is putting out leaves.

options.label: The best healer goes in among the sick, whatever it may cost them.

outcomes.text: They help a great many and are not taken by it.
They help a great many, but carry a little of it out with them, under the skin.

options.label: Leave supplies at the edge of the village and keep your distance.

outcomes.text: They wave their thanks from afar.

options.label: Burn it for everyone's safety, before the bark spreads.

outcomes.text: It is the safe thing to do. The child with leaves does not run.
